From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: proposed telemetry comparison + POC tests for Vertex eval

Ben / Marissa —

Copy of the external thread above. High priority POC coming for Vertex (DEAL-9812). They're evaluating Redwood alongside Vertex hosted and CloudGrid. I drafted a short qualification matrix and POC checklist — see summary below. I'll attach the full workbook to the Drive link after edits.

Key differentiators we should emphasize in the matrix (to call out vs hyperscalers):
- Token-level cost attribution (route + prompt attribution) — hyperscalers report aggregate token metrics; we can show per-route cost breakdown with sample dashboards.
- Prefix/KV-cache observability — Redwood can expose cache hit/miss traces per request, which matters for prompt engineering savings.
- Rollout and fallback telemetry — show traces across canary/A-B and automated fallback events (helps resilience arguments).
- Retention/export options: granular retention for telemetry vs coarse retention windows on some managed endpoints.

Proposed POC tests (minimal set, two weeks):
1) Latency microbench: 50k tokens across 3 routes, measure p50/p95/p99, compare with Vertex and CloudGrid.
2) End-to-end trace correlation: synthetic requests with trace_id passed through app -> inference -> logging backend; validate cross-system joins.
3) Cache-impact test: repeated prompt prefix test measuring token savings and exposing hit/miss metrics.
4) Cost attribution check: run mixed workload and verify per-route cost breakdown matches billing sample.

Operational asks for POC setup:
- Test accounts in us-west1 & us-east4 (Hannah to provide).
- Short-lived API keys for dev/test Dedicated nodes (we'll provide temp creds).
- Access to their tracing ingestion or a forwarder (Splunk/Datadog/Elastic) — if not available, we'll demonstrate with our dashboard export.

Next steps: I'll finish the matrix and sample payloads, target EOD Thursday (3rd). Ben, can you prepare a short demo script for the trace correlation (10–12 min) we can run in the walk-through? Marissa, can you add the retention/export rows and any legal caveats (SOC2 related) into the matrix?

Thanks —
Lauren
